subheader: Ali Einoder — generative art, tools, and fabrication

blocks.content: Ali Einoder builds creative tools, generative systems, and physical artefacts. This site documents the work: open tools, long-form projects, and process notes.

## Background

Design-engineering practice spanning parametric geometry, image pipelines, and browser-native tooling. Focus: deterministic export, owned concerns, and VGA-native interfaces.
